adds.title: Government Medical College Hospital, Kottayam transgender clinic and District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) proposal (2017)
adds.summary: By mid-February 2017 the Government Medical College Hospital in Kottayam was to open Kerala's first government clinic exclusively for transgender persons, operating twice a month with specialist doctors and also serving sex workers, with distribution of health cards denoting transgender status after a District Legal Services Authority proposal prompted by transgender persons' reported apprehension about approaching hospitals and reliance on self-medication, while DLSA also proposed separate public toilets for transgender persons to the district collector, and in January 2017 the Government Medical College Hospital in Thiruvananthapuram had completed its first sex reassignment surgery through staged procedures over three years.
